system.description:
You move through a watched space without becoming its most interesting feature.

Opposed by INT. Start out of sight. Success grants a non-attack Action before surprise; outside combat, may Move and Step.

upgrades.rank5: May make a surprise attack with Advantage.
upgrades.rank10: Other party crawlers using this skill untrained no longer suffer Disadvantage.
upgrades.rank15: On a successful Surprise check, may also Move and Step; a Surprise attack doubles its base damage dice.
